lines.q: Which is heavier, an African elephant or a hippo?
lines.a: The elephant! About six tonnes, four times a hippo.

lines.q: A fluffy cloud or a blue whale?
lines.a: The cloud! About five hundred tonnes of water, floating above you.
The giraffe! About twice as heavy as a big moose.

lines.q: Last one. A grizzly or a polar bear?
lines.a: The polar bear! The biggest bear on land. Think you can get all four? Go again!
